_note: Single source of top-level numbers for the K09-L quad tailsitter (redesign/CONFIGURATION.md). Owner: A1 (chief engineer). Every leaf is {value, unit, source, status?, note?}; sources are ids in redesign/params/claims.json or a repo path. Subsystem-local numbers live in redesign/subsystems/<key>/params.json. Change a value here only through A1 (team/<id>/CHANGE-REQUESTS.md); re-run team/A1/frame_claims.py afterwards. Status words: PROPOSED (design choice, to be re-derived by the owning role), UNVERIFIED (not compared with a primary source), CHECKED (compared).

configuration.note: quad tailsitter, flat flying wing, 4 fixed motors in X on two fins, 2 elevons, airspeed sensor, 4S, stands on fin tips, one-piece transport

revision.note: R1 = after the first analysis round (D-01..D-15): chord 0.32, S5010, motor tubes through the wing at x 0.045, pod forward, 11x5.5MR, CG 0.044, 45 mm feet, allocations 2 200 g. R2 = change-request round (D-16..D-23): box 0.50 m high, pod held at -0.105 until B3 re-derives the CG range, hover split limit 1.25, SM 0.05 kept, joint ownership rules. R3 = detail-analysis round (D-24..D-46): CG range 0.050-0.055 at R1 geometry (D-17 closed, pod stays, pack 4 mm aft of the pod centre), half-fins 0.21 m with two board layers, tube 0.344 m, 7 deg cant, feet 48 mm, pod nose shell -0.115 with a crush block, VD 27.2, n 3.4, thrust limit 21.1 N, box 0.54 m, AS150U, CoreWing F405 Wing V2, MS4525DO, allocations 2 324 g, reserve 276 g. R4 = integration round (D-47..D-58): CG fix (pod nose -0.130, pack bay 21 mm forward, pack nominal centroid x -0.022), CG range 0.050-0.0549 target 0.0522 (B3 R3), allocations 2 355 g / reserve 245 g, sag 0.851, cruise 240 W, THR_MAX 70 % cap keeps VD 27.2, prop plane -0.0077, cant sense corrected, box 3.57 kg, cost keys from I1-R3, shared R3 stations promoted

status.note: baseline for detailed design; reversible until the mid-December order on the conditions in CONFIGURATION.md

frame._note: Aircraft frame used by every CAD module, interfaces.json cg_xyz_m, the viewer and all analyses. Right-handed. Units: metres in files and code; Fusion receives cm (fusionkit does the conversion).

origin.value: wing root leading edge, on the chord line, in the plane of symmetry
origin.note: the only hard physical datum on a flat flying wing; CG is then read directly as a fraction of chord

x.value: aft (from the wing leading edge toward the trailing edge); +x is the direction of flight-path drag in cruise

y.value: to the right wing tip, seen from behind in cruise attitude

z.value: up in cruise attitude (toward the wing upper surface and the pod)

hover_attitude.value: nose up: +x points at the ground; the aircraft stands on the four fin trailing-edge tips (x = chord + foot)

symmetry_plane.note: ctx.mirror(plane='XZ') makes right-hand parts from left-hand ones

station_convention.value: part position = centre of its bounding box unless the subsystem params say otherwise; motors by shaft axis at the mount face

rho_kgm3.note: sea level; Richmond Field Station is ~5 m ASL

ambient_design_c.note: P19: E3 reports the field-ambient ceiling as an output; no 25 degC rule carried over

site.value: Richmond Field Station (FRIA), yellow sub-fields 1-4, 07:00-10:00 flights

ambient_ceiling_c.note: CHANGE-LOG D-42 (E3 CR-E3-07): field-ambient ceiling for the full mission (P19 output); 41 hover-only, 33 if the pack must land <= 50 degC; motor mounts and ESC pads in ASA. E3 re-runs on E2's re-run tables (~44)

pack_takeoff_max_c.note: D-42: pack temperature at take-off 20-34 degC by IR thermometer (H3 flight card; lower bound CR-E2-06)

full_throttle_max_s.note: D-42: no continuous full throttle (100 A limiter) longer than 10 s from a hover-warm motor (13.6 s to the winding limit); F4: no mode or failsafe demands sustained full throttle

requirements._note: Numbers the proof chain tests claims against. Text requirements (P1, P15, P17, P20...) are nodes in redesign/params/claims.json; A2 owns the full set in team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md.

mtow_gate_kg.note: P4: hard as-built gate = sized 2.48 kg + 5 %

mtow_sized_kg.note: CHANGE-LOG D-48: allocations 2 355 g + 145 g growth allowance + 100 g build overrun = the gate (was D-38: 2 324 + 170 + 100 = 2 594). Every performance, loads and control claim is computed at the 2.6 kg gate; the expected as-built mass is A3's CL-A3-MASS-PREDICTED (2 449 g with the 550 g pack)

hover_tw_min.note: P5: at the 2.6 kg gate on the maker's 14.8 V table

hover_tw_min_sag.note: P5: never below 1.6 with voltage sag

cruise_time_min.note: P3: after the 2 min hover; 10 min is a stretch target

growth_allowance_kg.note: P3 sizing growth allowance was a flat 250 g on 2 200 g of estimates (R0). D-38 replaced it by what the A1 reserve leaves after the 100 g overrun (276 - 100 = 170 g). CHANGE-LOG D-48: the R4 allocations carry every designer's own parts.csv (2 355 g), so the reserve is 245 g and the allowance 245 - 100 = 145 g. A3's growth by maturity on the delivered parts lists is 119 g (A3-R5, CL-A3-MASS-PREDICTED 2 449 g), inside it; the 680 g pack listing (+130 g) is not, and is decided by the pack weigh-in (CR-I1-13, E2)

build_overrun_kg.note: REVIEW section 2: first student foam build overrun, ESTIMATE

wind_limit_ms.note: P8: flight-card steady wind limit; hover and fin landing controllable

gust_survive_ms.note: P8: survive-and-land case, not an operating case

tipover_min_deg.note: static tip-over angle toward the pod side (narrow axis) at the worst flying CG (forward limit, z +0.03) must exceed the 5 m/s hover lean (16 deg) plus the 10 deg landing attitude error. CHANGE-LOG D-30 (C5 CR-C5-01, D5 CR-D5-01): pad contact at z +/-0.218 m (CL-D5-CONTACT-Z), z_cg subtracted; CL-A1-TIPOVER corner bound 30.6 deg, C5 worst flying CG 32.4 deg (CL-C5-TIPOVER-WORST); the 33 deg target of CR-A1-20 is retired; flight card: land with a wingtip into the wind (C5 S1-S8)

prop_clearance_min_m.note: minimum geometric gap prop tip to any structure or other prop; B4/D3 re-derive

static_margin_min.note: fraction of chord, cruise, elevons neutral; B3 keeps 0.05 (CR-B3-01, sets the aft CG limit); B2's trimmed CLmax 0.80 is at this margin

elevon_area_frac.note: DECISION section 5.1: 15-25 % of wing area; freeze on the foam-board twin

disconnect_factor.note: P18: connector rating >= 1.25 x peak continuous current

budget_usd.note: hard, incl. tax, shipping, packs, charger, radio, tools, spares

crash_reserve_planned_usd.note: P2: planned reserve at order time

crash_cost_usd.note: one bad class-S crash incl. tax (cost_model.py formula); the gate-1 reserve test

field_setup_max_min.note: P9: one person, no tools. CHANGE-LOG D-40: one 10 mm prop spanner in the box pouch is the single allowed tool (prop nuts 1.5 N m, C6 CR-C6-05, D7 CR-D7-05); A2 re-words R-FIELD-SETUP

box_external_m.note: P9 said 0.45 m high; D-16 made it 0.50 for the tube ends; CHANGE-LOG D-31 (D7 CR-D7-01): 0.54 because in a floor drop the aircraft sinks into the cradle foam by the ~70 mm stroke, so the lower tube ends and foot pads (z -0.219) need that travel above the floor: height needed 0.535 m (CL-D7-BOX-H-REQ). Freeze only after subsystems/transport/CAR-FIT.md has two measured cars; if a car rejects 0.54, fall back to 0.50 m with a 'max drop 0.15 m' label on the box (requirements.box_drop_m note)

box_mass_max_kg.note: P9: loaded. D-31: the flight packs travel in the LiPo bag beside the box, never in it (D7 CR-D7-07: 5.90 kg without packs, 7.00 with two)

box_wall_m.note: A1 fit-check allowance per side (CALC-A1-BOX). D-31: the built box uses a per-face stack (shell 4 mm, floor 4 mm, lid 10 mm, cradle foam under the spar) in subsystems/transport/params.json#trn.box; the drop case is D7's CL-D7-A1-BOX-DROP-ALLOW, not this fit check

requirements._note_limits: Limits adopted from A2 (CR-A2-01, team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md 'Numbers added by A2') and C1 (CR-C1-06, team/C1/LOADS.md) on 2026-11-09 (CHANGE-LOG D-14). PROPOSED until the owning role re-derives; A2 retires the ASM-A2-* duplicates and points the R-* nodes here.

load_factor_limit_pos.note: CHANGE-LOG D-29: was 3.0; CL-C1-GUST-N-POS 3.36 at VH 21.8 m/s with the 8 m/s gust line to VD 27.2 (B2 CL_alpha 3.48-3.58 /rad). Spar sizing unchanged (landing governs); wing shear and torsion already at 3.36

vd_ms.note: CHANGE-LOG D-29: was 22.4; VD = 1.25 x VH with VH 21.8 m/s. D-50 (B1 CR-B1-17, C1 CR-C1-20, F4 CR-F4-15): B1's VH at the 9 350 rpm cap is 25.7 m/s (CL-B1-VMAX), so VH is held at <= 21.8 m/s by F4's fixed-wing THR_MAX 70 % cap (7 750 rpm, level 21.3 m/s, CL-F4-VLEVEL-VH), shown in the first full-throttle level log (H2); C1 reads the capped VH and keeps 27.2 / n 3.4 (the 32.1 m/s alternative is rejected). q 454 Pa. Elevon schedule (F4 CR-F4-12): full travel to VA 20.5 m/s; the <= 1/3-at-VD half is held by envelope (no raw-stick FW mode, PTCH_LIM_MIN -10 deg, AIRSPEED_MAX 18, THR_MAX 70), not by an airspeed-dependent surface limit; servo stays B2's 3.93 kgf cm (CL-B2-SERVO-TORQUE-REQ); ARSPD_FBW_MAX <= 22

thrust_limit_per_motor_n.note: CHANGE-LOG D-29: was 17.8 (1.15 x 1.58 kgf). CL-C1-T-CAP 21.08 N = 11x5.5MR at the 9 350 rpm cap x E1 k_T 1.039; the 100 A limiter is time-filtered and does not bound a step to full throttle (F4 keeps the cap, CR-F4-07). H1 replaces it with the measured fresh-pack peak at the F4 cap, rounded up to 0.5 N (GT-02d, CR-H1-01). Only mount and motor loads change (+18 %)

landing_n_design.note: landing load factor the feet must hold the airframe to at the design sink (ASM-C1-N-LAND)

landing_attitude_err_deg.note: attitude error at touchdown in 5 m/s; sets the foot height with the wingtip-strike check (CR-C1-01)

foot_crush_stroke_min_m.note: CHANGE-LOG D-30: constant-force XPS cartridge (eta >= 0.8) with a >= 38 mm flange-to-sleeve gap (D-54, D5 CR-D5-16c: the gap is the stroke; usable after C5's 3 mm guard is 35 mm; a 38 mm usable stroke would need a 51 mm foot) and biased plateaus (upper feet x1.077, lower x0.923), from C5's planar landing model: the 17 mm z_cg offset pitches a level landing onto the pod-side pair and a pair-first touchdown lands the second pair harder (CL-C5-DROP-PAIR-PITCH 34.5 of 35 mm, n 5.84 / 5.54). C1's single-foot bound is >= 41 mm at eta 0.5 or >= 26 mm constant-force (CR-C1-17). Validated by T-C5-AIRCRAFT-DROP

box_drop_m.note: box slipping from a car sill, FLOOR drop (D-53, D7 CR-D7-12, C1 CR-C1-22). CHANGE-LOG D-22: kept; D7 puts crush foam under the spar cradles at y +/-0.20 m (D-53: 120 mm column, no lid lining, CL-D7-A1-BOX-DROP-ALLOW 0.339 m). D-31 corrects D-22: the stroke does cost box height, because the tube ends and feet sink with the aircraft (box 0.54 m). The aft-wall drop is taken by the four feet (0.25 m, CL-D7-AFT-N); end, nose and lid-down drops are label-and-test only (0.06-0.09 m): the box carries 'keep upright' (54-57 mm of end/side stroke would need ~0.2 m more box). If the car check forces the 0.50 m box, this value becomes 0.15 m (column 56 mm) and the box is labelled

crash_decel_g.note: pack retention case; C1 re-derived 12.75 g

spar_deflection_max.note: tip deflection / half-span at limit load; C2 re-derives

vibration_sep_frac.note: structural modes >= 20 % from 1P and 2P (J1 CR-J1-03, B4 CR-B4-07: keep tube and fin modes outside 80-330 Hz)

cnbeta_min.note: cruise, props included, elevons neutral (R-DIRECTIONAL); A2 0.03 over B3's 0.02: O4b gives +0.044 (CR-B3-02)

hover_ctrl_factor.note: control authority / disturbance at 5 m/s, every hover axis; B3 re-derives

hover_split_max.note: CHANGE-LOG D-18: largest allowed upper/lower pair thrust ratio for hover pitch trim (uses (s-1)/2 of the pitch differential, 12.5 % at 1.25); replaces A3's 1.10 placeholder ASM-A3-SPLIT-MAX. A3 roll-up 1.19 today (CL-A3-HOVER-SPLIT)

servo_torque_factor.note: rated stall torque >= 1.5 x hinge moment (B2 CL-B2-SERVO-TORQUE-REQ 3.04 kgf cm)

pitot_wash_clearance_radii.note: superseded in practice by B4's error bound (CL-B4-PITOT <= 2 %)

airspeed_err_max_ms.note: CHANGE-LOG D-37: was 1.0; the margin from cruise 16 m/s down to 1.3 Vs is 0.49-0.58 m/s (CL-B3-VT-TRIM 15.51, CL-B1-VT-GATE 15.42). F3's RSS budget 0.44 m/s (CL-F3-ASPD-ERR) after ARSPD_AUTOCAL and reciprocal legs; B4 wash 1.66 % = 0.27 m/s

hover_current_tol.note: P23 pass criterion on hover current

gust_thrust_headroom.note: T/W left while leaning in the 8 m/s gust

range_check_min_m.note: at 25 mW, the RadioMaster Pocket's lowest setting (10 mW is not offered); pass = LQ >= rc_lq_min AND best RSSI >= rc_rssi_check_min_dbm (F5 CR-F5-05/07, D-33)

rc_rssi_check_min_dbm.note: D-33: RSSI at 100 m and 25 mW that proves >= 10 dB margin at 515 m and 100 mW

gps_mast_clearance_m.note: from power leads, PDB and UBEC; F3 re-derives

ubec_factor.note: BEC rating >= 2 x servo stall current (F1 decides whether a UBEC is fitted)

thread_engagement_min.note: x nominal diameter into metal. CHANGE-LOG D-41 (C6): per-type minimums below; R-JOINT-STACK and interfaces/SCHEMA.md read these keys

thread_engagement_insert_min.note: D-41: x nominal diameter into a heat-set insert (= interfaces/SCHEMA.md)

thread_engagement_plastic_min.note: D-41: x nominal diameter self-tapping into printed plastic

nyloc_pitches_min.note: D-41: nyloc fully on plus 2 pitches showing

profile.value: vertical take-off -> hover (2 min total) -> transition at >= 1.3 Vs -> cruise >= 5 min -> back-transition -> vertical landing on the fin tips; no payload; VLOS inside one RFS sub-field

span_m.note: P6: one piece; may grow only if the measured car box allows

chord_m.note: CHANGE-LOG D-01: 0.30 -> 0.32 so the trimmed CLmax 0.80 gives Vs 11.9 m/s and 1.3 Vs 15.5 m/s at the gate; constant chord, rectangular, no sweep, no twist (B2 confirmed 0 deg)

airfoil.note: CHANGE-LOG D-02: Selig S5010 reflexed section (was MH 45): trimmed CLmax +4 %, softer stall (B2 WING-AERO.md section 2); coordinates subsystems/wing/s5010.dat (D1 copies from team/B2/airfoils/)

t_c.note: from the coordinate file; 31.4 mm at c 0.32

oswald_e.note: kept conservative for the whole aircraft: B2's AVL at R2 gives 0.94 (SM 5 %) / 0.92 (CG 0.044) for wing + 0.275 m half-fins, props off, no pod (P:b2.avl.e_oswald, CR-B2-14); B1 carries k 0.0950 base (e 0.93) and 0.1107 pessimistic (e 0.80)

material.value: XPS FOAMULAR NGX F-250, 2 in sheet, hot-wired

density_kgm3.note: conservative for F-250 (REVIEW section 2); weigh the first core

pieces.note: one-piece core, no wing joint; six cores per sheet

material.value: packing tape, 2 sides, spanwise strips 10 % overlap

areal_mass_kgm2.note: ESTIMATE incl. overlap; G2 weighs a sample

material.value: CF tube 22 x 20 mm, 1 000 mm stock, epoxied in a slot

length_m.note: stock length, centred: spans y = -0.50 to +0.50; outer 0.075 m per side is unspanned foam

x_m.note: 25 % chord at c 0.32, near the section's maximum thickness (~31 mm) so the 22 mm tube stays inside the foam; 35 mm behind the motor tubes (x 0.045); C2/D1 confirm

z_m.note: CHANGE-LOG D-03: on the S5010 camber line at the spar station so the tube has 3.7 mm of foam cover each side (B2 CR-B2-03, supersedes A5's 0.0048 placeholder); B2/A5 re-derive at c 0.32 (x/c 0.25)

mass_per_m_kgm.note: calc at rho 1.55 g/cm3; weigh the tube on arrival

elevon._note: Elevon surfaces are wing parts (cut from the core); hinge tape, horns, pushrods and servos belong to mechanisms. Baseline = two panels per side, one servo per side, 22 % chord (hinge at x = 0.2496 m). B3 confirmed the size (CR-B3-01); freeze after the foam-board twin (DECISION section 5.1).

chord_frac.note: B3 CR-B3-01: keep 22 % chord, both panels, 17.2 % of S; outboard panels alone would be 8.4 % (< 15 % floor)

panels_per_side.note: inboard (between pod and fin) + outboard (fin to tip), linked to one servo; the fin root at y = 0.32 splits the trailing edge (D6/D3 slot the lower fin half for the link, CR-A4-04)

inboard_y_m.note: 20 mm clear of the fin root (y = 0.32). The pod is 0.14 m wide since D-25, so the panel end is level with the pod side (y 0.07); the gap is real because the pod ends at x 0.095, 155 mm ahead of the hinge (A5 CALC-A5-ELEVON-GAPS measures the corner distance; CR-A5-18)

outboard_y_m.note: 20 mm clear of the fin root; 15 mm from the tip

deflection_deg.note: mechanical travel; F4 sets the servo limits

hinge.value: tape hinge on the upper surface, bevelled lower edge

fins._note: Two vertical fins at +/-0.32 m span. CHANGE-LOG D-04 (B3 option O4b): each motor tube passes vertically THROUGH the wing core at x = +0.045 m, 35 mm ahead of the spar; the fin leading edge is on the tube and the fin trailing edge is the wing trailing edge, so each fin is an upper and a lower half-fin behind the tube. Motors at the tube ends. The fin trailing-edge tips are the four feet.

y_m.note: +/-; motor station from centreline; 11 in props clear each other by 0.36 m

half_height_m.note: CHANGE-LOG D-26: was 0.19 (fin 0.38 m). Each half-fin now reaches z +/-0.21, the motor-mount lip, so the fin tips sit at the tube-end station: Cn_beta at the aft CG limit and 1.3 Vs 0.0286 -> 0.0373 /rad (R-DIRECTIONAL >= 0.03). C4 accepts with two board layers (CR-C4-20, separation 0.38); ~+6 g; props-off envelope unchanged (feet pads already at z +/-0.219). The motor stations stay at z +/-0.19

chord_m.note: from the motor tube (x = 0.045) to the wing trailing edge (x = 0.32); was 0.40 with the tube at -0.10

le_x_m.note: motor-tube centreline; fin leading edge on the tube

te_x_m.note: = wing trailing edge; feet at the tips

material.value: paper-faced foam board 3/16 in (4.8 mm), laser- or knife-cut

board_t_m.note: CR-A5-05: 3/16 in nominal; measure one board. Sets the elevon end gaps and the foot width

layers.note: CHANGE-LOG D-26: two 4.8 mm boards laminated (spray adhesive) with the CF brace and 10 x 1 mm edge strips. D3's one-layer option (CR-D3-02) is rejected: on D3's geometry its first station mode is 228 Hz, 14 % from cruise 2P (CL-C4-D3-SEP-1L 0.14 FAIL); two layers give 0.41 (worst E/G 0.33). The board carries the motor twist because the tube stops below the motor (fins.tube.length_m)

pieces_per_fin.note: upper and lower half-fins either side of the wing; instance ids use the station codes of the README rule, FIN-001-UR / UL / LR / LL (upper right ...), one suffix family per part number (CR-A4-15b, CR-A5-15; D3's RU/LU/RD/LD in CR-D3-08 is rejected, D-26); the tube is continuous through the core

material.value: CF tube 22 x 20 mm, cut from 1 000 mm stock

length_m.note: CHANGE-LOG D-26: was 0.42 (z +/-0.21). The tube now ends at z +/-0.172, 18 mm below the motor axis, inside the printed mount's collar and lip cap, so the four motor screws can be reached from behind the plate; the mount carries the motor past the tube end (C4: rocking stiffness >= 900 N m/rad, CR-C4-17). -7.8 g per tube. Passes through the core (31 mm thick at y 0.32)

x_m.note: centreline, = fins.le_x_m; through a vertical 22 mm hole in the core at y = +/-0.32 (core ~27 mm thick there); cruise Cn_beta +0.044 /rad modelled (CL-B3-CNB option O4b)

stations._note: CHANGE-LOG D-55 (A5 CR-A5-16, D7 CR-D7-08c): shared R3 stations promoted from the designers' files so the datum sheet (fusion/DATUMS.md), D5, D7, C4 and C5 read one source. PROPOSED copies of the owners' values; a designer changes them only through A1.

collar_end_xyz_m.note: brace end on the station collar ear (DX-COLLAR-<st>): on the tube axis x 0.045, |y| 0.3023, |z| 0.1535 (collar ring z 0.1435-0.1595, D3 CR-D3-21)

brace_anchor_y_m.note: brace anchor centre on the spar line (DX-ANCHOR-<st>), 20 x 16 mm pocket at (0.080, +/-0.242) (CR-D3-03)

brace_anchor_y_in_m.note: inboard edge of the anchor hardware (0.234-0.250): the transport cradles stay inboard of it (trn.cradle.brace_anchor_y_in_m points here, D-31)

saddle.value: printed PETG through-core block 69 x 36 mm at y = +/-0.32 (vertical bore for the motor tube at x 0.045, spanwise bore for the spar at x 0.080, 35 mm apart) bonded into a full-depth core pocket; a 19.8 x 36 mm PETG plug inside the spar at each block and 20 mm plugs at |y| 0.242 under the brace anchors (C2); each half-fin is braced by a 10 x 3 mm CF strip from a station collar on the tube (z +/-0.1535) to an anchor on the spar at y +/-0.242, with 10 x 1 mm CF edge strips and a 40 mm two-face collar tail (C6)
saddle.note: D-04 block (P25) as designed by D3 and sized by C4 (CL-C4-D3-BLOCK-MS +0.55, separation 0.41 with two layers) and C2 (plugs: ring MS -0.96 without, bearing +2.7 with); mounts and ESC pads printed in ASA (E3 CR-E3-01, D-42); collars and anchors PETG

motor.note: E1 confirms; 1 spare in the BOM

motor_length_m.note: CHANGE-LOG D-51 (E1 CR-E1-29b): mount face to bell top (was 0.025, can only); E1/D3 confirm on the first motor (T-E1-MOTOR-RM)

esc.note: 4 fitted + 4 spare; reflash to Bluejay if bidirectional DShot wanted

current_max_per_motor_a.note: with Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX 100 A (motor rating 25 A / 30 s); unlimited 42.4 A at 14.8 V and 51.6 A at 16.8 V (CL-E1-IMAX-*), above the ESC's 45 A

download_factor.note: B4 models 1.036-1.046 with the tube at x -0.10 (CL-B4-DOWNLOAD); kept at 1.06 until T-B4-INSTALLED, and B4 re-runs with the tube at x 0.045 (the disc edge is now 35 mm above the wing LE)

telemetry.value: over the ELRS link (CRSF), telemetry ratio 1:4, no separate radio
telemetry.note: D-33: a SiK pair (~$35-60) or ELRS MAVLink mode only if the reserve later exceeds the crash cost by its price

remote_id.value: none fitted (RFS is a FRIA); $44 module from reserve if another site is used

envelope_props_off_m.note: D-47, D-54: span incl. the TE corner caps (0.8 mm each side, D5 CR-D5-16a) x (pod nose -0.130 to foot tips 0.368, pitot boom removed) x (foot pads splayed to z +/-0.219, D5 CR-D5-01; mount caps at +/-0.2075). CL-A1-BOX-FIT is the geometric fit against the 0.54 m box with 25 mm per side (slack 2 mm along the chord after the 15 mm nose extension, 48 mm in span, 52 mm in height); D7's real box has a 4 mm shell and a 1 in PE nose pad with a relief hole: D7 re-fits the nose (CR-D7-13: antenna tube B must end <= 10 mm ahead of the nose). Was [1.15, 0.483, 0.438] (D-31)

field_steps.value: TX on; fit 4 props (one M6 nut each, 10 mm spanner from the pouch, LH thread on the CW motors), plug in the pitot boom (barbed couplers), pack in and strap, close the AS150U, arm check
field_steps.note: D-40: the prop spanner is the one allowed tool; D7 budget 265 s

cradle.value: two spar cradles at y +/-0.20 m (saddle 60 mm wide on a 120 mm crush-foam column, no lid lining) with lid hold-down pillars over the spar; fins, tubes, braces, collars and tube ends exposed, never pressed; the saddles bear on the tape skin WNG-003 (also_contacts)
cradle.note: REVIEW section 7; D7 CR-D7-03/04 and D3 CR-D3-11: brace anchors sit at y +/-(0.234-0.250) (fins.stations.brace_anchor_y_in_m), so the cradles stay inboard of 0.23; wing patches y +/-(0.17-0.23) kept free of hardware (D1, D6). D-53 (D7 CR-D7-08b): column 120 mm (was '>= 70 mm stroke', ~127 mm of foam that bottomed 2 mm off the floor); CL-D7-A1-BOX-DROP-ALLOW 0.339 m, drop n 10.1 <= 11.0

carry.value: three items per trip: the box (5.84 kg loaded, props and packs out), the tote with the LiPo bag and chargers, and the landing mat / spares can
carry.note: D-53 (D7 CR-D7-12c): carriers 6.4 / 6.0 kg; the 0.8 x 0.8 m landing mat (3 mm ply + 1.5 mm rubber, C5 mu 0.7) is TRN-104 (CR-D7-17, I1)

motor_temp_max_c.note: motor base / winding limit E3 sizes to (SunnySky X3108S, 13.6 s to the winding limit from a hover-warm motor at full throttle)

esc_temp_max_c.note: ESC FET limit (LANRC 45 A); pad 61.6 degC at the mission ceiling

pack_temp_max_c.note: pack at landing (E2: cells <= 60 degC, 10 K guard); 47.1 degC at the mission ceiling (CL-E3-PACK-END)

fc_temp_max_c.note: FC board (STM32F405 85 degC ambient class); 57.0 degC peak (CL-E3-FC-PEAK) before the stack split (F3 CR-F3-14: 0.5 W at the FC, BEC losses on PWR-003)
